items.item_text: Designs, develops and supports critical endpoint infrastructure, including but not limited to Windows OS, MacOS, iOS, SCCM, JAMF, mobile device management, antivirus, file sharing, databases, license management, advanced scientific applications, and cloud based services. Maintains experience with and expertise in scientific software programs and workflows, particularly those by Psychology and Brain Science researchers. Analyzes environment and designs, implements and supports services and tools to meet faculty, staff and scientific computing needs. Maintains a high level of understanding of industry practices. Evaluates and tests new systems and services. Develops moderately complex software and scripts to accomplish tasks and streamline workflows. Performs regular security audits and verifies compliance with requirements and policies.
Bachelor's degree in related area or equivalent experience/training
1-3 years Experience with proactive defense, incident response and analysis
1-3 years Experience with planning for deployment and creation of feedback mechanisms
1-3 years In-depth experience with network diagnostic and performance management tools and software

Develops and maintains Active Directory identity infrastructure with oversight from Manager of Desktop Services. Ensures health and integrity of domains and critical supporting Operating Systems, services and computers. Coordinates necessary updates to maintain high levels of functionality and security. Implements and develops tools, extensions and scripts to enhance the Active Directory service for LSCG staff and supported users. Performs regular security audits and verifies compliance with requirements and policies.

Defines, designs, and implements storage solutions based on users' needs. Configures and deploys data storage infrastructure and helps to manage user access to various shared resources. May perform networking tasks to interconnect servers or components of clusters to storage infrastructure. Creates usage reports and identifies areas which need improvement.

Serves as a point of escalation for desktop support technicians. Provides high level support for Windows desktop OS. Develops scripts and programs to assist in desktop support workflows. Coordinates with Helpdesk Manager and User Support Manager to investigate processes, techniques and tools to bolster desktop support operations. Facilitates research needs in Psychology and other supported departments.

Assists in training and development of desktop support staff. Develops and maintains internal training materials and public documentation and webpages pertaining to Desktop, Mobile, Server, Active Directory, Wireless, and other areas. Holds regular training briefings for all desktop support staff pertaining to existing and new services.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
